covers: The NEC uPD1990A and uPD4990A serial calendar and clock chips as a chip

left_out.why: same class family, pins and handlers as upd1990a (it is listed in that chip's types); what differs is a year byte in the register, a serial command mode and the data pulse rate, written in the upd1990a register and command entries

entries.name: uPD1990A RTC
entries.description: Serial calendar and clock chip: a driver sets three command pins, strobes, then shifts the time in or out one bit at a time.
entries.behaviour: Everything is a pin level, one handler per pin. The command comes from C0 to C2 when STB rises, and CLK shifts the time register while the shift command is active. DATA OUT and TP are returned by reads and also sent to callbacks.
